listings.rawTitle: Molecule 01 Eau de Toilette Spray with Metal Case 30ml
listings.description: Created with only one single ingredient, Iso E Super, Its chemistry adapts to the wearer and is different for every person. It is less an aroma and more an effect that lends an indefinable radiance to the wearer.It is characterised by a modern cedarwood note with a velvety sensation. The wearer may notice a pleasant, subtle velvety-woody note which will vanish, then re-surface after some time. This is due to the way it bonds with receptors. It's slow releasing to make way for a fresh charge of the molecule on the receptors.Iso E Super is a molecule that sits close to the skin to create a divine aura around the wearer. It does not exist in nature, It was created in a laboratory in 1973 and is designed to be worn by both men and women.Occasionally the wearer can not smell Molecule 01 and this can be due to a few reasons. Firstly the only ingredient is the aroma-molecule Iso E Super. This belongs to a group of fragrance materials such as musk and while some people are highly sensitive to it, a small few find them hard to smell. Also, the fragrance is slowly released and vanishes only to re-appear again later. While the wearer may experience this loss of scent others can still smell the molecule on them. Or lastly, it could be possible that the wearer is experiencing Hyposmia (smell blindness) in most cases this is temporary and a small break from wearing the fragrance can fix the problem.

listings.description: Please note that the plant comes in a 12cm nursery pot as standard, Keep the compost moist during the warmer months, but in winter you should reduce the amount it gets, and only water them occasionally. Ideally when watering, you should let them stand in a tray of water (or kitchen sink)so they can soak up as much as they like for an hour or two. Afterwards, let the excess water drain away completely. It is always best to give thema good soak when they get quite dry, rather than watering little and often. Their preference is for soft, tepid water. They love humidity, so a bright kitchen or bathroom would be ideal, and mist the leaves with water occasionally, especially if they are in a heated room. Don't worry if the roots grow outside the pot. In their native area, they grow in the crooks of branches, and use these aerial roots to absorb water from the air. They do not mind being over crowded in their pots, so you only need to repot them when the growth starts to suffer. Position: bright, indirect light Soil: specialist orchid compost Rate of growth: average Flowering period: off and on throughout the year Hardiness: tender (indoors only) Current height: approximately 50cm (+ or - 10% including the pot) Number of stems: 2 flower stems Pot cover: choose a 14cm orchid pot cover to give a good fit over the pot
